title: Normalized geometric operations on semilinear systems
statement: Fix a category C with object universe c and morphism universe v, a Grothendieck topology J, an EssentiallySmall.{max c v r} instance, a tower B of commutative ring sheaves in universe max c v r with transitions tau, and the ordinary system calculus Data of [def-coef-semilinear-derived-calculus]. Given another such site (C′,J′) and a geometric morphism presented by uInv adjoint to uPush on sheaves of sets in that universe, with uInv preserving finite limits, there exists a Geometry of [def-coef-semilinear-geometry-ops] for these data satisfying its PullTransitionFormula. This constructs only the geometric branch; it does not construct coefficient extension or open localization.

theorem semilinearGeometricOperations (systems : Data.{c, v, r} J B τ)
    {C' : Type c} [Category.{v} C'] [EssentiallySmall.{max c v r} C']
    (J' : GrothendieckTopology C')
    (uInv : Sheaf J (Type (max c v r)) ⥤ Sheaf J' (Type (max c v r)))
    (uPush : Sheaf J' (Type (max c v r)) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type (max c v r)))
    (adjSet : uInv ⊣ uPush) [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv] :
    Nonempty {G : Geometry.{c, v, r} J B τ systems J' uInv uPush adjSet //
      G.PullTransitionFormula J B τ systems J' uInv uPush adjSet}
